execution_analysis.archive_integrity: Both supplied SHA-256 values verified. All 33 CRX members in each archive match the supplied extraction byte for byte; no ZIP comments. Both MP4 top-level box sequences cover their complete files without trailing bytes.
execution_analysis.extension_entrypoints: Manifest V3 new-tab override loads only packaged scripts. Service worker js/background.js; permissions search, alarms, storage; sole host grant api.gameograf.com. Neither manifest grants broad site access or declares content scripts.
execution_analysis.background_path: Install-only guard opens a fixed publisher landing page, calls fetchAndStoreAll and registers a 30-minute alarm. Startup and alarm paths refresh JSON. fetchMessage and fetchShortcuts parse response.json and cache the objects in chrome.storage.local. Uninstall URL carries a fixed wallpaper post number and UTM attribution; no per-user identifier is appended.
execution_analysis.shortcut_path: js/script.js reads cached apiShortcuts and reacts to storage changes. It merges removable publisher links with local user links, checks http/https URL schemes, then interpolates record fields into HTML and appends with jQuery. This is unescaped publisher-controlled markup. Scheme checking does not escape HTML attributes or icon/name fields. No navigation is forced by rendering; clicks follow anchors. Existing HTML interpolation findings remain accurate. Loading publisher-supplied icons contacts their configured hosts; the favicon fallback sends the shortcut URL to Google. These are explicit UI resource requests, not evidence of theft of browser history or credentials.
execution_analysis.banner_path: js/popup.js reads popupMessage from local storage and destructures title/message/buttonText/buttonUrl/timestamp/sponsored. It ignores the remote legacy html field, writes textContent for text and sets an anchor href for the button. An Ad label is conditional on sponsored; the current feed omits that flag. Users can disable the banner or dismiss a message for twelve hours.
execution_analysis.search_path: A user Enter/click calls chrome.search.query using the default provider. The callback incorrectly expects results[0].url; the official API returns void, so that branch does not establish search hijacking.
execution_analysis.other_features: Weather sends an optional user-entered city and caches returned data; automatic location is resolved server-side. ChatGPT navigation is initiated by the user and includes their typed query. Local notes/todos/background images/settings stay in browser storage. FileReader reads a user-selected image. Countdown synthesizes an audio beep, without microphone capture. Calculator dispatches among arithmetic functions rather than eval.
execution_analysis.obfuscation_and_library: Application scripts are readable. Minified jQuery 3.7.1 is byte-identical to the official upstream download (SHA-256 fc9a93dd241f6b045cbff0481cf4e1901becd0e12fb45166a8f17f95823f0b1a). Its Ajax and script-element machinery are library capabilities. The application does not explicitly evaluate feed data as JavaScript; unescaped shortcut markup can still attempt element/script insertion, subject to the Manifest V3 default CSP. The current feed contains ordinary records, not an executable stage. Full facts and relevant member facts yielded no decoded executable stage.
execution_analysis.properties: The full 58-byte file consists only of KEYSTORE_FILE, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS and KEY_PASSWORD assignments, all empty. It supplies neither secrets nor instructions, URLs, executable content or a consumer. This identifies configuration syntax, not a project or signing operation.

verdict_balance.extensions: The install landing page, fixed uninstall attribution and remotely refreshed publisher promotions are adware-like and can be unwanted. In these exact builds they accompany working advertised UI, remain on extension-owned pages, provide dismissal/removal controls, and do not perform hidden ad clicks, repeated forced tab openings, cross-site injection, credential collection, remote source execution or IndexedDB deletion. Ordinary monetized new-tab behavior is the stronger explanation for these bytes; consent and historical builds are not supplied. Benign is a judgment of the submitted builds, not an endorsement of the publisher.
verdict_balance.properties: An empty configuration template has no standalone executable or credential-theft behavior. No external hostile provenance or embedding project was supplied for this file.

external_evidence.campaign_observation: The retrieved report identifies Gameograf at publisher/campaign level and describes forced advertising traffic, IndexedDB deletion and unsanitized popup HTML. These two exact IDs are absent from its retrieved example list. Publisher association or different versions can explain the external label; those reported destructive/execution behaviors are not in these submitted builds. Shortcut HTML interpolation is present and retained.
external_evidence.live_feeds: message.json is a Gameograf Styles promotion; shortcuts.json contains Wallpapers, Amazon, Youtube, Netflix, Styles and Anime Games. The promotional go.php URL redirected to the Chrome Web Store listing named Gameograf Styles. Both install URLs retrieved wallpaper product pages with standard WordPress UI, advertising and analytics. Publisher UI scripts were fetched and inspected. Official jQuery was fetched and hash-compared.
limitations: Both automatic and manual-city weather requests returned HTTP 204, leaving no response body to analyze.
Remote responses are mutable and historical server responses are unavailable. No complete interactive Chrome runtime session was performed.
Normal navigation links to Google services are not automatic executable dependencies. The promoted Styles extension is reached through a user click, not auto-installed by this sample.

handler_rename.reason: Optional async keyword in existing matcher permits synchronous callbacks. Preserve exact matcher/criticality/scope and update its HTTP response-relay consumer.

identifier_relocation.reason: identifiers.count <= 6 is a static identifier population, not a sidecar/configuration role. Preserve matcher/defaults/criticality and the only exact consumer. No relevant ancestor-directory consumers exist.
identifier_relocation.budget_audit: Original metadata/package/config leaf has 100 rules and no equivalent effective definitions. The misplaced count observation was corrected rather than raising the budget or inventing a category.

additions.reason: Paired keystore declarations describe blank and populated configuration, without asserting signing or embedded secrets.
AST-bound textContent assignment of the Ad label describes explicit advertising-label UI; comments and other text do not match.
